items.question: What is Wakeel AI?
items.answer: Wakeel AI is an AI-assisted HR workspace designed to bring HR management, documentation, compliance context and everyday HR assistance together.

items.question: Who is Wakeel AI for?
items.answer: Wakeel AI is built for companies, company owners and HR teams that need a focused place to manage HR operations.

items.question: Does Wakeel AI work with Egyptian labor law?
items.answer: Wakeel is designed to use Egyptian labor-law context as part of its HR assistance. It does not replace professional legal advice.

items.question: Can company owners and HR staff have different access?
items.answer: Yes. Wakeel AI supports a role-based approach so company owners and HR staff can access the workspace responsibilities relevant to them.

items.question: How much does Wakeel AI cost?
items.answer: Wakeel AI costs $30 per company per month or $300 per company per year.
